(2) Through the CHARGE the total overpotential is only ~0.05 V (the eta_e 0.0398 constant at the kappa 2.0 + the SEI ~0.01 + the small kinetics), so the clean V ceiling = OCP_c_max 4.696 - OCP_n_min 0.092 + 0.05 = 4.654 < 4.70: the clean 4.7 V trip is UNREACHABLE - the trip comes only at the ANODE KINETIC SATURATION (the n -> 0.9998, the eta_n -> -0.077) -> the anode potential plunges 0.043 -> -0.234 in 2 s -> the V spike -> the trip. (3) The fix: deliberate IR - lower the electrolyte conductivity (the sanctioned formulation lever) so the eta_tot(4C) = 0.0796/kappa + 0.012 clears the needed 4.70 - 4.40(dip) + 0.092 = 0.392 V, i.e., the kappa <= ~0.209, and the V = 4.70 fires in the OCP_c flat dip with the anode at 0.5-0.7 (the huge margin to the saturation). The Q_c/Q_a balance alone cannot fix this: the trip needs the anode near-full regardless of the Q_c.
